def ordered_routes(

    *,

) -> tuple[ExpandedRoute, ...]:

    routes = list(plan.routes)
    if not routes:
        return ()

    if (
        options.shuffle_fallbacks

    ):
        shuffler = SystemRandom() if options.shuffler is None else options.shuffler
        fallbacks = routes[1:]
        shuffler.shuffle(fallbacks)
        routes = [routes[0], *fallbacks]
